# Slambient 200 Deep

Ficha do template `slambient-deep` (versão 1). Estilo: Slambient.

Slambient at 200 BPM: intro 16, a deep soft kick and a muffled KBBB sub pulse in C (held notes that skip a 16th or a beat in each bar) for almost the whole song, a low boom every 4 bars, two breaks of 8, two dips that keep the low end and a long dark part carried by the drone with no hats; a W-Core drone and a noise texture as the layers, no lead. 448 bars, about 9 minutes. A hypothesis until Diogo hears it.
